symbols.name: chunk width
symbols.meaning: The number of address bits in each consecutive chunk, a count of bits.
symbols.quote: Here $K$ is the number of address bits in each chunk and $D$ is the number of participating axes, each of which contributes one chunk of $K$ consecutive address bits.

symbols.name: participating axes
symbols.meaning: The number of participating axes, each contributing one chunk, a count.
symbols.quote: Here $K$ is the number of address bits in each chunk and $D$ is the number of participating axes, each of which contributes one chunk of $K$ consecutive address bits.

symbols.name: selected offset
symbols.meaning: The position, counted from the least significant bit of a chunk, of the bit selected in every chunk.
symbols.quote: Here $\rho$ is that common offset, the position of the selected bit within each chunk, counted from the least significant bit.

relations.quote: The layout is built from [address-field interchange](address-interchange.md) moves of whole chunks, together with single-bit moves.
The layout prepares the input for each [simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md) of a transform round.
The layout is applied within each round of the [synthetic polynomial transforms](synthetic-transforms.md).
